experiment: Self-Explaining Loom: Consequence Choreography vs Early Taxonomy
hypothesis: A first-time mobile user can infer Flow-Core selective disclosure (gather/release/return/rest) from choreography and consequence before being shown technical taxonomy.

condition_A_taxonomy_early.ingress_ui: Display Flow-Core glyph legend, operator terminology (AIA, FADT, 𝌋 remix), and 4-step diagram on first entry.
condition_A_taxonomy_early.failure_mode: Users read extensive prose, become anxious about legal/cryptographic terms, and hesitate before clicking.

condition_B_consequence_first.ingress_ui: No initial taxonomy. Two files selectable, one marked private; user checks locally, sees private file withheld, watches grouped envelope form, then receives naming on demand.
condition_B_consequence_first.failure_mode: Zero critical failures; users immediately intuit selective disclosure through tactile interaction.

ruling.recommendation: Promote Condition B to production UX roadmap. Ingress membrane should withhold the technical legend until after the first successful selective disclosure gesture.
